title: Stale status.json files of closed sprints crowd live ones out of `autopilot.py status`, and `close` never prunes _cache/autopilot/SP-*
goal: autopilot.py status lists only sprints that still have an item file, with an `ended error` or `ended timeout` before `ended sprint-done` and the newest first, so a failed run is never hidden behind `+K more`; `backlog.py close` removes (or archives) _cache/autopilot/<sprint>/ of the sprint it closes; planted-failure tests cover the order, the filter and the prune; found by the SP-itmjxudu review

run: import sys,json,tempfile,pathlib;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import autopilot;r=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());w=[("SP-aaaaaaaa","sprint-done"),("SP-bbbbbbbb","sprint-done"),("SP-cccccccc","sprint-done"),("SP-dddddddd","error")];[((r/"_cache"/"autopilot"/s).mkdir(parents=True),(r/"_cache"/"autopilot"/s/"status.json").write_text(json.dumps({"sprint":s,"cause":c}))) for s,c in w];out=autopilot.runner_lines(str(r),3);print(out);sys.exit(0 if any(x and "dddddddd" in x for x in out) else 1)
